findings.description: Critical: D7/D8 claim every range run gets a fresh per-run snapshot, but the chosen directory key is only generated_at rounded to seconds plus git_sha. Two standalone range audits started in the same second at the same repository HEAD will target the same openspec/choices/<run-id>/ directory; the existing choices_ledger.write_ledger_pair path merges into an existing choices.json, so separate range snapshots can be combined or overwritten while still passing the planned later-now tests.
findings.resolution: Make the standalone run directory collision-safe without using raw uncontrolled path text, and add a regression test for two range audits at the same now/git_sha, including different audited ranges. For example, derive a sanitized suffix from existing ledger contents such as header.run_id plus audited_range, or detect an existing run directory and allocate a deterministic disambiguator; then assert each invocation gets an isolated ledger and latest.* points to only the newest run.
